# Requirements Quality Checklist: provider-summary

**Purpose**: Requirements quality validation for the provider-summary CLI command feature.
**Created**: 2026-09-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are exact output schemas defined for both human-readable text and JSON formats? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Are default fallback values explicitly specified for missing or unverified provider states? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK003 Are exit codes specified for all expected failure modes including invalid arguments and unreadable data? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, §AC-009]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the required fields and Python types documented for internal data structures? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK005 Are empty provider catalog and zero-model scenarios fully specified? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK006 Are requirements defined for stderr diagnostic messaging on execution failures? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, §AC-009]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is the exact JSON output format unambiguous and free from extraneous characters or logs? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, §AC-002]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the textual representation of provider availability strictly defined between OK and UNAVAILABLE? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, §AC-010]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the term "local abstractions" quantified with concrete registries or components to reuse? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, §AC-003]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the prohibition of subprocesses and external agent CLIs explicitly bounded to specific providers? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, §AC-004]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the definition of "traceback suppression" unambiguous regarding uncaught exceptions versus handled errors? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, §AC-009]
- [ ] CHK012 Are the data types for provider attributes strictly specified without ambiguity between null, 0, or boolean types? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, §Key Entities]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 Do the availability semantics align consistently between text output (OK/UNAVAILABLE) and JSON boolean (true/false)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002, §AC-010]
- [ ] CHK014 Do the model count specifications agree across user stories, functional requirements, and edge cases? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK015 Are architectural constraints in §FR-007 consistent with the core principles of the project Constitution? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, Constitution §III]
- [ ] CHK016 Does the zero-subprocess requirement in §FR-003 align with the non-destructive local reuse mandate? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §FR-004, Constitution §III]
- [ ] CHK017 Are the error handling requirements in §FR-005 consistent with CLI ergonomics standards in §IV? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Constitution §IV]

## Requirement Testability & Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK018 Can the absence of external subprocesses and LLM calls be objectively verified in automated tests? [Testability, Spec §AC-004, §AC-005, §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK019 Are JSON output validity and schema conformity measurable via deterministic parsing? [Testability, Spec §AC-002, §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the TDD RED-to-GREEN transition objectively verifiable through test failure and pass criteria? [Testability, Spec §FR-006, §AC-007]
- [ ] CHK021 Can exit codes and stderr messages for invalid CLI arguments be tested independently without mock fragility? [Testability, Spec §AC-009, §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK022 Are regression suite invariants objectively verifiable with standard test runner invocations? [Testability, Spec §AC-006, §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK023 Can the handling of unverified provider states be tested using isolated local test fixtures? [Testability, Spec §AC-010, §AC-011, §SC-005]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
